property: A later path-level MTU discovery algorithm is built from the existing IPv4 DF bit plus ICMP fragmentation-needed feedback rather than by redesigning the IPv4 header.
negative_claims: This edge does not claim that RFC 791 originally defined Path MTU Discovery.
This edge does not claim PMTUD is an IPv4 Option; it uses a base-header flag and ICMP error signaling.
open_questions: Trace implementation into BSD/Linux and later PLPMTUD.
notes: Canonical example of new operational machinery grown from old wire primitives.
